items.headline: India's Retail Inflation Surges to 6.09% in October, Exceeding RBI Tolerance
items.summary: India's CPI-based retail inflation rose to 6.09% in October 2026, driven by higher food prices, marking the first time it breached the RBI's 6% upper limit in two years.

items.headline: RBI Expected to Hike Policy Rate in December Amid Rising Inflation
items.summary: Elevated inflation figures have led economists to anticipate an RBI policy rate hike in its December 2026 meeting. SBI Research revised its projection to a 25 bps hike, citing moderating crude and improved rupee stability.

items.headline: Wall Street Ends Lower on Tech Uncertainty, Rising US Bond Yields
items.summary: Global sentiment is cautious as Wall Street closed lower due to uncertainty in the technology sector and increasing US bond yields, with Nvidia shares seeing a drop.

items.headline: Asian Markets Show Mixed Trends; Crude Oil Prices Remain High
items.summary: Asian markets are mixed, with Kospi and Hang Seng down, while Nikkei and SSE Composite are up. Crude oil prices are trading around $95.40-$95.70 due to Middle East supply concerns.

items.headline: Dilip Buildcon Q2 Net Profit Halves Despite Revenue Growth
items.summary: Dilip Buildcon reported a 52.7% YoY decline in net profit to INR 1.0 billion for Q2 FY27, even as revenue increased by 16.8% YoY to INR 22.5 billion.

items.headline: Hitachi Energy India Reports Strong Q2 Profit and Revenue Growth
items.summary: Hitachi Energy India's Q2 FY27 net profit rose 20.5% YoY to INR 3.2 billion, with revenue significantly up by 63.5% YoY to INR 30.0 billion.

items.headline: Manappuram Finance Q2 Net Profit Jumps Over 200%
items.summary: Manappuram Finance posted a robust Q2 FY27, with net profit surging 222.7% YoY to INR 7.0 billion and revenue growing 44.7% YoY to INR 19.6 billion.

items.headline: Oil India's Q2 Profit and EBITDA Decline QoQ
items.summary: Oil India reported a 21.3% QoQ drop in net profit to INR 22.6 billion and a 26.5% QoQ fall in EBITDA in Q2 FY27, despite a marginal revenue increase.

items.headline: Realty, Media, and PSU Banks Show Strength in Previous Session
items.summary: In the previous trading session, sectors like Realty, Media, and PSU Banks demonstrated strength, indicating potential positive momentum for these segments.

items.headline: Auto, FMCG, IT Sectors Under Pressure; Financials Decline in Early Trade
items.summary: The Auto, FMCG, and IT sectors faced pressure in the previous session, while financials, Realty, Chemicals, Cement, Oil & Gas, and Private/PSU Banks traded lower in early November 13 trade.

items.headline: Dharti Proteins Sets Record Date for 1:1 Bonus Issue
items.summary: Dharti Proteins has scheduled November 13, 2026, as the record date for its 1:1 bonus issue, meaning shareholders will receive one additional share for each share held.

items.headline: Highway Infrastructure to Issue Convertible Warrants for Project Funding
items.summary: Highway Infrastructure Ltd approved the issuance of convertible warrants on a preferential basis to its promoter group, aimed at funding upcoming hotel and real estate projects.

items.headline: Mahindra & Mahindra, HDFC Bank Among Major Laggards in Early Trade
items.summary: Key stocks like Mahindra & Mahindra, HDFC Bank, InterGlobe Aviation, Trent, Bharat Electronics, and Bajaj Finserv were notable laggards in early trading.

items.headline: HCL Tech, Hindustan Unilever Among Early Gainers on November 13
items.summary: In early trading on November 13, HCL Tech, Hindustan Unilever, Tech Mahindra, and Sun Pharma emerged as early gainers, showing positive momentum.

themes: Financial Sector Buoyancy & Realty Rally: Strong performance in NIFTY BANK, NIFTY FIN SERVICE, and NIFTY REALTY suggests continued bullish sentiment, possibly driven by domestic economic growth expectations and FII inflows.
IT Sector Under Pressure: NIFTY IT's significant decline indicates headwinds, likely due to global macro concerns, cautious client spending, or valuation adjustments.
FII-led Market Resilience: Robust FII inflows are counteracting DII selling, providing underlying support to benchmark indices despite broader market breadth issues.

Commodity Price Volatility & Input Cost Watch: Mixed performance in NIFTY METAL and losses in companies like BPCL and Pidilite Ind. indicate sensitivity to global commodity prices and input cost pressures, a factor to watch.

Monsoon Progression & Rural Demand Outlook: With the monsoon season underway, its progression will be critical for agricultural output and, consequently, rural demand, impacting FMCG and auto sectors.

fiiDiiWeekly.summary: Foreign Institutional Investors were net buyers with weekly inflows of ₹34,818.22 cr, supported by DII net activity of ₹-29,111.53 cr.

portfolioFocus.name: Eicher Motors Ltd.
portfolioFocus.recentEvents: Strong Royal Enfield sales performance for June, positive analyst commentary on premium motorcycle segment growth.
portfolioFocus.upcomingCatalysts: Launch of new 450cc platform models, Q1 FY25 earnings call providing demand outlook, potential export market expansion.
portfolioFocus.riskNote: Increasing competition from Bajaj-Triumph and Harley-Davidson-Hero, slowdown in discretionary consumer spending, commodity price inflation.

portfolioFocus.name: Hindustan Unilever Ltd.
portfolioFocus.recentEvents: Easing input cost pressures (palm oil, crude derivatives) improving margin outlook, cautious but optimistic commentary on rural demand recovery.
portfolioFocus.upcomingCatalysts: Q1 FY25 earnings results expected in late July, monsoon season progression influencing rural consumption, new product launches in health & hygiene.
portfolioFocus.riskNote: Intense competition from local and regional players, potential for sustained high food inflation impacting consumer purchasing power, adverse monsoon leading to rural demand weakness.

portfolioFocus.name: Bharti Airtel Ltd.
portfolioFocus.recentEvents: Continued subscriber additions and strong ARPU growth, persistent market speculation around potential tariff hikes in the telecom sector.
portfolioFocus.upcomingCatalysts: Q1 FY25 earnings report, accelerated 5G rollout and monetization strategies, potential consolidation activities in the sector.
portfolioFocus.riskNote: Regulatory risks including spectrum pricing and AGR issues, aggressive competition from Reliance Jio, high capital expenditure requirements for 5G infrastructure.

portfolioFocus.name: Pidilite Industries Ltd.
portfolioFocus.recentEvents: Profit booking after a strong rally, concerns over elevated crude oil prices impacting key raw material costs (VAM), slightly subdued real estate market in certain micro-markets.
portfolioFocus.upcomingCatalysts: Q1 FY25 earnings, update on raw material price trends, sustained growth in construction and housing sector activities.
portfolioFocus.riskNote: Volatility in crude oil and derivatives prices impacting margins, slowdown in construction/infrastructure spending, intense competition from unorganized sector players.

portfolioFocus.name: Bharat Petroleum Corporation Ltd.
portfolioFocus.recentEvents: Global crude oil price volatility impacting inventory gains/losses, government focus on energy transition and strategic investments in green fuels.
portfolioFocus.upcomingCatalysts: Q1 FY25 refining margins and marketing segment performance, potential updates on strategic divestment plans, progress on expansion projects.
portfolioFocus.riskNote: Geopolitical events influencing crude oil prices, government policy changes on fuel pricing and subsidies, environmental regulations and energy transition costs.
